# Drugzone Pharmaceuticals Inc.

> > NABP-accredited pharmaceutical distributor providing FDA/DSCSA-compliant wholesale drug distribution for human and animal health across the United States.

Drugzone Pharmaceuticals Inc., based in Nanuet, NY, serves pharmacies nationwide with comprehensive pharmaceutical distribution services including generic drugs from manufacturers like Sun Pharma, Dr. Reddy's, and Aurobindo. The company specializes in DSCSA 2025 compliance and maintains rigorous quality standards across both human health and veterinary supply chains.
